baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural reciprocal verb at focus word 2 governs the food at word 4 for the person characterized at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is made socially mobile by reciprocal exhortation: each person is responsible not only to feed but to activate another feeder, so the censured failure is a broken relay of pressure and transfer.

activation_trace.role: Urging and incitement supply the interpersonal pressure engine, while the reciprocal plural makes that pressure circulate.
Feeding another or asking to be fed gives the circulating pressure a concrete transfer endpoint.
Poverty, weakness, and abasement identify the condition that the failed social relay leaves unrelieved.

changed_reading.before: The addressees fail to recommend an individual charitable act.
changed_reading.after: The addressees fail to reproduce a communal norm in which people press one another until nourishment actually reaches the person in need.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction links exhortation to food and then to a noun from the settlement/stillness root.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food expands from a meal into livelihood and an allocable share; the recipient's root then makes that provision what permits continued residence and material stability.

activation_trace.role: Exhortation supplies the collective action needed to secure an ongoing share rather than an isolated mouthful.
Provision, livelihood, earnings, revenue, and legal share widen food into the material basis of a person's condition.
Provision that enables remaining in place makes stable subsistence the functional result of that share.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns prompting someone to give a needy person food.
changed_reading.after: The verse concerns mobilizing a sustaining livelihood or share by which a materially vulnerable person can remain established.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes an activation verb with a recipient root whose branches include stillness, low status, and settled position.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sound cluster of exhortation also carries an image of low ground, while the recipient root carries stopped movement; social urging can therefore be carried as counter-motion generated at a social low point.

activation_trace.role: Low ground at a mountain's foot spatializes the point from which the needed counter-motion must begin.
Cessation of movement renders need as material immobilization rather than only low income.
Capacity to do something lets nourishment function as restored ability, not merely consumption.

changed_reading.before: No one advocates strongly enough for the poor.
changed_reading.after: No communal counterforce is generated for a person immobilized at the social low point; nourishment would restore practical capacity and motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rupture opens a route, pairing adds one unit to another, deprivation leaves a unit short, and nocturnal flow carries movement onward. Together they sharpen reciprocal exhortation into a relay that joins isolated agents and moves provision through a stalled social field.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and emission provide the opening action by which a blocked provision route can begin.
Joining a thing to its like models one participant recruiting another into the exhortation chain.
A deficit that strips a right or work supplies the isolated shortfall that the paired relay must answer.
Running and permeating flow turns recruitment into transmission rather than a static moral opinion.
The focus exhortation is the local anchor for the inferred person-to-person relay.
Livelihood and allocable provision are what the relay is inferred to move.

structural_cues: The opening sequence moves from rupture through pairing and deprivation into passage before the later reciprocal plural.
Pairing and unpairing coexist, allowing recruitment and isolation to remain competing social states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: rupture, joining, rights-depleting lack, and running flow; inference: reciprocal exhortation links people into a transmission path for provision; live alternative: the opening images may remain oath imagery without specifying a welfare relay.

changed_reading.before: People fail to remind one another to feed.
changed_reading.after: People fail to pair up and propagate a provision-bearing impulse across the very separations that leave a person short.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context displays coordinated capacity to support, cut, fix, and monumentalize, followed by exceeded limits and systemic spoilage. The focus then exposes a selective incapacity: the same society that can organize matter and power does not organize provision for the vulnerable.

activation_trace.role: Columns and structural supports establish organized load-bearing capacity.
Penetrating cutting contributes directed technical force.
Massive hard rock makes the achieved material resistance explicit.
Upright fixedness like a stake supplies durable political and architectural anchoring.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion redirects organized capacity into domination.
Departure from sound order names the systemic result of that redirected capacity.
The absent organization is anchored in the failure of reciprocal mobilization.
Livelihood and material shares identify the neglected infrastructure.

structural_cues: The packet orders engineered capitals, rock cutting, stakes, transgression, and corruption before the focus accusation.
The focus plural makes the contrast one of collective organization, not technological inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: load-bearing structures, penetrating cuts, fixed stakes, exceeded limits, and spoiled order; inference: capacity was selectively organized for power while provision lacked an institution; live alternative: the ruined peoples may illustrate arrogance generally rather than a specific allocation failure.

changed_reading.after: The community possesses formidable coordination but allocates it to monuments and domination, leaving the needy person's sustaining infrastructure deliberately unbuilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Poured force, whipping, punitive pain, and surveillance form a complete vertical enforcement system. Against it, the negated reciprocal exhortation becomes the absence of horizontal enforcement for nourishment: pressure exists, but it is aimed at bodies rather than at those withholding provision.

activation_trace.role: Pouring gives punitive force a directed, descending delivery.
The whip and striking make coercive pressure materially explicit.
Painful punishment names the endpoint of the vertical pressure system.
Watching and guarding supply the surveillance that makes enforcement continuous.
Urging is the focus's alternative pressure technology, negated precisely where provision is concerned.
Feeding another fixes the missing horizontal pressure to an observable transfer.

structural_cues: A concentrated punishment-and-watch sequence immediately precedes the human trial and care failures.
Vertical coercion and reciprocal exhortation provide opposed directions of pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: poured force, whip, punishment, and watch; inference: the focus condemns not pressure itself but a society whose pressure is vertically punitive and horizontally absent where food must move; live alternative: the punishment images may describe divine response only, without mirroring human institutions.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are passive toward hunger.
changed_reading.after: The addressees inhabit a pressure-rich order, yet none of its discipline is turned laterally against the withholding of nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is a test that reveals the recipient of abundance, but human speech converts ease into proof of honor and restriction into proof of abasement. Failure to mobilize food then performs that false status judgment publicly: deprivation is treated as deserved identity rather than as a distribution problem.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals a condition makes abundance diagnostic of the holder's response, not proof of rank.
Honor and praised generosity expose the ambiguity between being honored and acting generously.
Good condition and ease supply the abundance that is misread as personal validation.
Restriction to a narrow measure supplies scarcity without assigning moral inferiority.
An apportioned gift frames resources as allocated provision rather than self-authenticating merit.
Humiliation through contempt names the false social conclusion drawn from restriction.
Livelihood and share make redistribution the practical answer to the misread trial.
Need and abasement are the condition society wrongly converts into a verdict on worth.

structural_cues: The paired first-person verdicts on abundance and restriction are immediately overturned before the care accusations.
Speech about status is followed by plural conduct, linking private misreading to public allocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: test, honor, ease, restriction, apportioned provision, and contempt; inference: refusal to mobilize food socially enacts the false equation between scarcity and deserved humiliation; live alternative: the preceding speech may diagnose only an individual's theology, though the following plural conduct shows its social consequence.

changed_reading.before: People neglect those whom circumstances have impoverished.
changed_reading.after: People ratify a false theology of wealth by treating restricted provision as evidence of low worth and therefore refusing to redistribute the test placed in their own hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The orphan branch names a child severed from a sponsor. The focus's reciprocal exhortation can therefore function as distributed guardianship: when one vertical care bond is absent, a horizontal network recruits replacement providers and restores household-level support.

activation_trace.role: Honor expressed as praised generosity makes care an action that confers standing, not a label possessed by the wealthy.
A child cut off from a caregiver supplies the broken vertical care relation.
Reciprocal urging supplies redundancy by recruiting care beyond one missing sponsor.
Household and its inhabitants provide the social unit that distributed guardianship seeks to reconstruct.
Livelihood turns reconstructed care into durable maintenance rather than a symbolic welcome.

structural_cues: Failure to honor the sponsorless child is placed directly before failure to exhort concerning the needy person's food.
The first failure is a broken care bond; the second uses a reciprocal plural capable of replacing it with a network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: honor through generosity, severance from a caregiver, reciprocal urging, household, and livelihood; inference: horizontal exhortation is social redundancy for a missing guardian; live alternative: orphan and needy person remain distinct recipients even if the adjacent failures expose one care-system defect.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks people to advocate for a generic needy recipient.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks the community to become a redundant care network, recruiting provision when a person's ordinary sponsor or household support has failed.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, inheritance is consumed, dispersed assets are gathered, and wealth is intensely loved until accumulation is full. These cues turn the needy person's food from an optional gift into a livelihood-share intercepted by an appetite-driven concentration process.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood, revenue, and legal share permit food to be heard as an allocable economic claim.
Provision that enables staying identifies what is lost when the share is intercepted.
Consuming and taking wealth converts eating into asset absorption, not bodily hunger alone.
Transfer from predecessor to heir identifies the stock being absorbed.
Gathering scattered things supplies the concentration operation.
Extreme desire supplies the appetite that drives concentration.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth names the concentrated object.
Accumulation until fullness gives the appetite its terminal shape.

structural_cues: The focus's food phrase is immediately followed by eating inheritance and loving amassed wealth.
Bodily eating and economic consumption occupy adjacent clauses, making resource capture materially legible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: livelihood/share, wealth-consumption, inheritance transfer, gathering, desire, and fullness; inference: the focus genitive can be heard as the needy person's due provision being intercepted; live alternative: the genitive may remain purely beneficiary-oriented, yielding food for rather than food owned by the needy person.

changed_reading.before: The wealthy fail to donate food that belongs to them.
changed_reading.after: An accumulation system consumes the very livelihood-share that should stabilize the needy person, while reciprocal silence protects the interception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembrance arrives only after exposure, followed by the wish to have sent something ahead for life. This makes exhortation time-sensitive logistics: its value lies in moving provision before need hardens and before retrospective recognition can no longer alter the transfer.

activation_trace.role: Recovering something after forgetfulness supplies recognition that can arrive too late.
Advancing something forward supplies the prospective transfer missing from belated remembrance.
Life as benefit and good makes the advanced provision productive rather than merely credit-bearing.
Exhortation is the focus act whose timing can move other agents before the transfer window closes.
Livelihood is what must be positioned prospectively rather than remembered retrospectively.

structural_cues: Remembrance is presented as no longer useful and is followed by a wish for prior advancement.
The earlier negated exhortation is an unrealized speech act, so timing belongs to its mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recovered memory, forward advancement, and life as benefit; inference: mutual exhortation pre-positions sustaining resources while action remains possible; live alternative: advancement for life can denote good deeds generally rather than a specific provision flow.

changed_reading.before: The missing exhortation is deficient moral content.
changed_reading.after: The missing exhortation is a missed temporal intervention: speech failed to move livelihood forward while it could still sustain another life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Individual dispersion stands beside a root that ranges from trust and covenant to fastening and shackles. The reciprocal focus verb can thus be read as a voluntary social bond around provision; where that bond is refused, binding returns in coercive form.

activation_trace.role: Separation into individual units supplies the atomized condition opposed to reciprocal mobilization.
Trust and repose in something reliable supply the voluntary basis of a durable care bond.
A confirmed covenant gives that voluntary bond a collective obligation.
Fastening and shackles reverse the same binding capacity into coercion.
Reciprocal urging is the focus mechanism by which isolated agents could bind themselves to provision.
Rest and comfort name the condition that a trustworthy provision covenant would secure.

structural_cues: The repeated incomparable individual is followed by repeated binding language.
Reciprocity in the focus supplies a horizontal bond that can be contrasted with the later coercive bond.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: individual dispersion, trust, covenant, and shackling; inference: society either binds itself voluntarily to sustain the vulnerable or encounters binding as coercion; live alternative: the context's binding is punishment alone, and the covenant contrast is a branch-triggered analogy.

changed_reading.before: Individuals fail to encourage one another.
changed_reading.after: Atomized individuals refuse to form a trustworthy covenant around sustenance, allowing social bond to reappear only as punitive restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Relief, tranquility, return, mutual satisfaction, entry, and sheltered garden form a movement from distress into stable belonging. The focus food can therefore be carried as one stage in social re-entry: provision makes rest, dwelling, and membership possible rather than merely serving an external recipient.

activation_trace.role: Relieving constriction supplies the transition out of material distress.
Stillness and reassurance provide the restored condition toward which provision moves.
Return to a prior place supplies restoration rather than first-time admission alone.
Mutual satisfaction makes belonging reciprocal rather than a one-sided donor-recipient hierarchy.
Movement into an interior gives restored belonging a boundary-crossing action.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies the final image of protected habitation.
Livelihood is the material means by which re-entry can endure.
Dwelling and settlement anchor the reading in restored residence.
Rest and familiar comfort turn residence into experienced belonging.

structural_cues: The closing movement progresses from an addressed self through return and mutual satisfaction to repeated entry.
The focus recipient root already contains dwelling and comfort, allowing the closing trajectory to reactivate it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: relief, tranquility, return, mutual satisfaction, entry, shelter, livelihood, and dwelling; inference: feeding participates in restoring a person to stable communal interiority; live alternative: the closing movement is eschatological and may contrast with, rather than model, present social reintegration.

changed_reading.before: Food passes outward from a giver to an external needy person.
changed_reading.after: Mobilized livelihood carries a vulnerable person back across the boundary into rest, dwelling, reciprocity, and protected belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a visual source expression activates a non-dominant split mapping concerned with carrying water. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in the focus's livelihood and staying branches, but downstream prose should preserve the ordinary visual reading and label supply-carrying as a split-root activation rather than a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus links provision at word 4 to the capacity to remain at word 5.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and carrying water converts perception into the exploratory logistical image of transporting sustenance.
Livelihood and provision supply the material that must be transported.
Provision that permits staying supplies the logistical endpoint.

changed_reading.before: One should notice need and urge feeding.
changed_reading.after: Seeing becomes incomplete until a supply medium is carried into place so that the vulnerable person can remain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples the focus root's low-ground branch with the later physical leveling of earth. It remains anchored in the focus's activation-versus-stillness contrast, but downstream prose should present it as a spatial resonance about inequality, not as an etymological equation or a claim that the verse explicitly commands economic leveling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places an activation verb whose inventory includes low ground beside a recipient root of stopped movement and settled position.

activation_trace.role: Low ground at a mountain foot locates vulnerability at the bottom of a vertical field.
Cessation of movement makes the person at that low point unable to exit unaided.
Flattening and lowering supply the later total leveling against which ordinary redistributive counter-motion is imagined.
Earth as the lower realm gives the leveling image a shared spatial substrate.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns interpersonal encouragement to charity.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes a refused everyday counter-leveling: no one generates the provision that could move a person from immobilized social low ground before the final leveling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context's love-root activates its seed branch while the focus food-root activates ripening, turning wealth into unrealized nourishment. It remains anchored in food's maturation branch and the explicit wealth-accumulation sequence, but downstream prose should mark it as latent agrarian-economic wordplay rather than the syntax's primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Food at focus word 4 has a branch in which fruit takes flavor and reaches edible maturity.

activation_trace.role: Ripening and taking on flavor make nourishment the outcome of a productive process.
A seed that germinates and bears grain turns the love-root into latent productive capital.
Accumulated wealth supplies the stock that could have been planted into provision.
Gathering until fullness depicts that productive stock as withheld in a heap.

changed_reading.before: Hoarded wealth competes with charitable spending.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is hoarded seed: its concentration prevents a productive cycle from ripening into the needy person's food.

strongest_changes: Reciprocal exhortation became a social relay and an institution of distributed care, not merely advice to an individual donor.
Food became sustaining livelihood and a potentially rights-bearing share that inheritance consumption and wealth concentration can intercept.
The surrounding monument and punishment systems exposed not incapacity but misallocated collective capacity: coordination exists for domination and coercion, not provision.
The trial sequence made non-feeding a public enactment of the false belief that restricted provision proves deserved humiliation.
The closing return-and-entry sequence reactivated the recipient root as dwelling, comfort, and restored belonging.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three-root mechanism repeatedly changed domain without losing its anchor: activation moved provision toward settlement, while context supplied paired relays, monumental organization, coercive pressure, status error, asset capture, timing, covenant, and re-entry. These readings coexist because each specifies a different failure in the same transfer system.
remaining_uncertainties: The economic claim is strongest if the food genitive can carry a rights-bearing sense; a beneficiary-only reading weakens ownership language but not the distribution mechanism.
The split sight-to-water mapping, low-ground leveling, and seed-capital model are deliberately branch-distant and should remain marked exploratory.
The closing movement may offer a social analogy of reintegration, an eschatological contrast, or both; the packet does not force one direction.
